paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : Informativeness and missing step values of 4 representative LLMs

annotations.annotation: The plot displays the trends in "Missing Step" values for two methods labeled as "0-CoT" and "CoRe". The x-axis is labeled with an unspecified label, uses a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 4, and has a tick label interval of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Missing Step", also uses a linear scale and ranges from 0.835 to 0.850 with tick labels at intervals of 0.005. The first line, representing "0-CoT", is depicted in blue with a dashed line style and circular markers. It starts at approximately 0.850 on the y-axis at x=0 and follows a downward trend, ending at around 0.832 at x=4. Notably, data points are observed at y=0.845 at x=1, presenting a decline throughout. The second line, representing "CoRe", is shown in orange with a solid line and triangular markers. It begins at approximately 0.855 at x=0 and demonstrates a sharp decline till x = 1, then steady decline, concluding at around 0.838 at x=4. The lines never intersect, but come very close at x = 1. A legend is given top right.
